I only grepped the files and did not read them in full. dogwhistle/honest.py (D) is the best match. Suggested time: about 35 min on honest.py, to confirm the arm-by-replicate slot completeness check and the protocol check. dogwhistle/visibility.py (C) is second. It defines eligible_targets (line 49), which honest.py depends on, and it has a similar validator (line 100). Suggested time: about 15 min on visibility.py, to check what counts as eligible. Spend the last 10 min skimming study.py (A) and heldout.py (B) to rule them out. Both validate with eligible_coalitions only and never mention honest-1.0. I did not keep the incoming handoff's B and D. B (heldout.py) does not match the request, because it has no honest-1.0 check and no use of eligible_targets. dogwhistle/listener.py also has a validate_registration that uses eligible_targets, but it is not in the candidate list, so I did not budget time for it. I did not confirm that honest.py checks slot completeness.
